$comment: The sessions `pnpm session` (session.mjs) and its native twin `cargo xtask bench session` (orb-bench's session.rs) both run, so that a session means the same style, camera and hand on the web and natively.

`style` is a catalogue key as load.html takes it (data/scenes.json's, or `alps`, styles.js's key-only entry); The demo's own styles (data/scenes.json's local entries) open with the map options' defaults, as the demo opens them; `globe` instead puts the style on the globe under the demo's sky alone (load.html's `?globe`, data/globe-sky.json). `at` is the first camera, the style's own `center`, `zoom`, `bearing` and `pitch` filling what it leaves out. `pause` is the ms between moves.

Moves, timed from their first event; points are fractions of the viewport: `wheel`, `n` notches of `delta` px at `at`, `ms` apart, negative zooming in; `drag`, the primary button from `from` by `by` px over `ms`; `turn`, the secondary button from the centre (tilts and turns), as a drag; `fling`, `levels` zoomed in (out, negative) by wheel notches `ms` apart, each a notch Orbis zooms a third of a level by; `scroll`, `levels` zoomed by a trackpad's 8 px every 8 ms; `fly`, the camera's centre carried straight from lon, lat `from` to `to` over `ms`, a step every 16 ms. A drag is held still 150 ms before its release, so no engine glides on and every engine ends where the hand stopped.
